title: Work IQ: memory profile path in Work IQ MCP for agents
summary: Hold: the agent-memory control links to an overview that no longer documents its configuration, and the retention description uses the wrong inactivity trigger. Current documentation measures the 28 days from the last use of a user's memories, not their last interaction with the agent. Historical directions in the briefing's verifier comment were treated as content, not instructions.
